name: Nitrazepate
summary: Nitrazepate (Lorzem) is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative and has anxiolytic properties. It is normally produced as its potassium salt, potassium nitrazepate.

pharmacology.text: Nitrazepate (Lorzem) is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative and has anxiolytic properties.

uses.en: It was sold under the name Lorzem as an anti-anxiety medicine.
uses.zh: 它曾以 Lorzem 的商品名作為抗焦慮藥物販售。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以 Lorzem 的商品名作为抗焦虑药物贩售。

sideEffects.en: Benzodiazepines cause drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and memory gaps. Regular use leads to tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause seizures, which can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 苯二氮平類會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與記憶斷片。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，大量使用後突然停藥可能引發癲癇發作，甚至有生命危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 苯二氮平类会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与记忆断片。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，大量使用后突然停药可能引发癫痫发作，甚至有生命危险。

fact.en: Like clorazepate, it is usually made as a potassium salt, which helps the powder dissolve. The body converts such compounds into the active benzodiazepine.
fact.zh: 與氯氮平酸鹽類似，它通常製成鉀鹽以幫助粉末溶解。人體會把這類化合物轉變為有活性的苯二氮平。
fact.zhHans: 与氯氮平酸盐类似，它通常制成钾盐以帮助粉末溶解。人体会把这类化合物转变为有活性的苯二氮平。
